SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital literacy : Learner develops digital citizenship skills as he/she uses a digital device to search for more information

on marine life

• Learning to learn: Learner practises picking out details from a listening or observing text

Values:
• Responsibility : is nurtured as the learner interacts with texts on how to take care of natural resources

Link to other subjects:

● Kiswahili and Kenya Sign Language teaches good listening, observing, speaking and signing skills
